requirement: Each search may examine at most 100 rows at the declared 1000000-row cardinality; inserts must write at most one identical status index. Order pages must preserve requested offset semantics.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE day = ? AND active = false ORDER BY name COLLATE locale OFFSET 900000

join.sql: orders JOIN lines USING(order_id) JOIN tags USING(order_id)
join.required: one order total and its tag list
